Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Large joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complete radial tear at the posterior root of the medial meniscus with moderate extrusion and reactive marrow edema at the periphery of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the weightbearing medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema related to medial compartment pathology. Intact.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 5 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:


1. Complete radial tear at the posterior root of the medial meniscus with extrusion and medial compartment chondrosis, as described.

2. Large joint effusion.

МР находка: Дясна колянна става: МР данни за медиална гонартроза. Виждат се множество дефекти в ставния хрущял от медиалната страна на фемура. Хрущялът е изтънен и е с неравни контурни очертания. Изобразяват се остеофити по кондилите на фемура, предимно от медиалната страна. Наличие на субхондрален едеме на костния мозък в медиалния фемурален кондил, във връзка с дегенеративните промени в подлежащия хрущял. Ставният хрущял от латералната страна на ставата е запазен. Визуализира се дегенеративна промяна и лезия на медиалния менискус в областта на неговия заднен рог. Задният рог на медиалният менискус е с висок интензитат на сигнала и е фрагментиран. Част от менискуса е изместен латерално от ставната междина. Дегенеративна промяна се открива и при педния рог на латералния менускус, с малка /6мм./ киста в него. Наличие на ставен излив. Кръстните връзки са интактни. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Сухожилие на мускулус квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – без особености Лява колянна става: Вижда се медиална гонартроза и при лявата колянна става, която е сравнително по-изразена. Ставният хрущял от медиалната страна е лизиран почти изцяло, като ставната междина е изпълнен с течност. Изобраяват се сравнително по-големи остеофитни наслагвания по феморалните кондили.  Малки остеофити се намират и по ставните краища на тибията. Наличие на субхондрален костно-мозъчен едем във феура и в тибията от медиалната страна. Медиалният менискус е дегенеративно променен и е фрагментиран. Латералният менискус е сравнително запазен. Изобразяват се кръстните връзки и колатералните лигаменти. МР данни за мукоидна дегенерация на предната кръстна връзка. Връзката се проследява по цялото и протежение, но е с уголемен напречник и повишен интензитет на сигнала. Колатерални лигаменти -  б.о.  Ставен излив. Заключение: МР данни за двустранна медиална гонартроза, сравнително по-изразена при лявата колянна ставна. Двустранен ставен излив. Лезия на задните рога на медиалните менискуси – grade 3.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytes.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tearing and maceration of the body of medial meniscus with severe extrusion. Reactive marrow edema along the medial tibial plateau.
Medial compartment cartilage: Moderate cartilage loss throughout the medial compartment.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Inner margin blunting of the body of lateral meniscus.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Moderate cartilage loss with areas of full-thickness fissuring throughout the lateral compartment. No marrow edema,

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness cartilage loss throughout the lateral patellar median ridge and medial patella with subchondral cystic change. High-grade cartilage loss throughout the trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. There is marked MCL bursitis. 

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complex tearing of the medial meniscus body with severe extrusion. 
2.	Tricompartmental osteoarthritis, severe in the patellofemoral compartment. If there is persistent pain, geniculate nerve ablation can be considered. 
3.	There is marked MCL bursitis. 
4.	Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, there is radial tear at the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact The popliteofibular ligament is intact The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.  Radial tear at the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus of left knee.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia derecha atraumática.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios que sugieran una rotura categórica.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa.
No hay alteraciones significativas de la grasa de Hoffa.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
No hay otros hallazgos relevantes que consignar en estas secuencias.
Impresión:
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Twisting injury left knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The medial meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

1. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.
